title: lantana camara f. urticifolia
intro: Lantana camara f. urticifolia, commonly known as Yellow Sage, is a plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Sage are primarily attributed to its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in soothing sore throats, coughs, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Sage include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
